title: Mohanan Kunnummal takes swipe at SFI protesters at Kerala University farewell

ai.summary: Kerala University Vice-Chancellor Mohanan Kunnummal criticized SFI protesters at a farewell event, highlighting academic achievements while noting ongoing staff shortages and concerns over campus disruptions.

facts.claim: Kerala University Vice-Chancellor Mohanan Kunnummal took a swipe at campus protests
facts.quote: Kerala University Vice-Chancellor (V-C) in-charge Mohanan Kunnummal on Thursday took a swipe at campus protests and highlighted the university’s achievements during his tenure at a farewell function organised ahead of his retirement on November 28.

facts.claim: Students Federation of India (SFI) activists were protesting on university premises
facts.quote: The event was held amid protests by Students Federation of India (SFI) activists on the university premises.

facts.claim: Kerala University issued 1,90,202 degree certificates and 1,564 PhD certificates during the V-C's tenure
facts.quote: Reflecting on his four-year tenure, he said Kerala University has issued 1,90,202 degree certificates and 1,564 PhD certificates.

facts.claim: 126 of the university’s 150-odd teachers received promotions during the V-C's tenure
facts.quote: He also claimed that 126 of the university’s 150-odd teachers had received promotions during the period.

facts.claim: The university continues to face a shortage of permanent teaching staff
facts.quote: The university, however, continues to face a shortage of permanent teaching staff, he added, while calling for more faculty positions.

facts.claim: V-C expressed concerns over disruption of academic activities through campus agitations
facts.quote: He expressed concerns over the purported disruption of academic activities through campus agitations.

ai.background_note: Kerala University Vice-Chancellor Mohanan Kunnummal addressed SFI protesters at a farewell event before retiring on November 28, 2026, amid ongoing protests related to delayed appointments for lower primary school teacher rank holders.
